Ah I see — the tr_* arrays are still created (the argsort block survived), then `del src, dst, ...` deletes the local names, so my new merge code can't find `src`. Let me remove the tr_* block (keeping the sort) and use the sorted arrays directly.

Let me replace the block from `order = np.argsort...` through `del wbl, del_` with just the sort assigning to local names.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='topo.py'; s=open(p).read()
old = """        order = np.argsort(src, kind='stable')
        self.tr_src = src[order]
        self.tr_dst = dst[order]
        self.tr_wb = wb[order]
        self.tr_de = de[order]
        self.tr_kind = kind[order]
        self.tr_gmax = gmax[order]
        self.tr_bl = blok[order]
        del src, dst, wb, de, kind, gmax, blok, order
        wbl = self.tr_wb.tolist()
        del_ = self.tr_de.tolist()
        self.tr_wpy = [(a << AGE_SH) + b for a, b in zip(wbl, del_)]
        del wbl, del_
"""
new = """        order = np.argsort(src, kind='stable')
        src = src[order]
        dst = dst[order]
        wb = wb[order]
        de = de[order]
        kind = kind[order]
        gmax = gmax[order]
        blok = blok[order]
        del order
"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
